description: Complete original Lightdash commissioning application with installed project setup, one shared browser/MCP owner, managed Applications and complete customer handover receiving. Includes editable customer operating procedures, original native outcome observations and complete returned-plan review.

commandDescriptions.lightdash-project: Prepare, open and operate an original Lightdash commissioning project through shared browser and authenticated MCP.
commandDescriptions.lightdash-receive: Receive and reopen a complete original Lightdash handover with its included application and detached workspace.
commandDescriptions.lightdash-installed-receive: Continue the same completed Lightdash operation through installed MCP, managed Applications and customer receiving.
commandDescriptions.lightdash-operating-plan: Author customer operating procedures from original Lightdash source and native outcomes; receive complete history and review returned changes without dispatching commissioning work
